description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger model within 2" of this model makes a ranged attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model’s ranged weapon gains +2 POW when resolving that attack.

name: Immobile
description: This model has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

name: Crate
description: This model cannot have damage removed from it.

name: Arcane Ammunition
description: While within 2" of this model, friendy Faction models' ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical.

name: Inconsequential
description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

name: Medical Crate
description: At any time during its activation, a friendly living Faction model within 2" of this model can cause it to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, either remove d3+2 damage from the living model or return one destroyed non-character model to its unit. The model returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned model within 2" of the model that caused this model to suffer damage. The returned model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Battlefield Medicine
description: When a friendly model with Tough is disabled while within 2" of this model, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, remove 1 damage point from the model with Tough; it is no longer disabled and does not become knocked down.

name: Weapon Crate
description: When a friendly Valiant warjack without a Heavy Weapon contacts this crate, it can gain a Heavy Flamethrower, Howitzer, or Rocket Pod Heavy Weapon, then the crate is removed from play. The warjack gains the heavy weapon and +1 ARM for the rest of the game. Additionally, the turn the warjack gains the Heavy Weapon it also gains one focus point.

name: Relentless Charge
description: While advancing as part of a charge, this model gains Pathfinder.

name: Heavy Weapon Hardpoint
description: This model can have an airdropped heavy weapon.

name: Evasive
description: When this model is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can advance up to 2".

name: Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: Rapid Fire
description: This model can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.

name: Elite Cadre [Jack Marshal]
description: When a model controlling this warjack makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of this warjack the controller gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Mantlet
description: Friendly medium and small-based warrior models in base contact with this defence gain +3 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Fuel Canister
description: At any time during its activation before making its Normal Movement a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the construct model gains +2 SPD that activation.

name: Augment
description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model makes a melee attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model gains +2 to its next melee damage roll.

name: Arcane Fuel
description: At the start of its activation, a friendly Gravedigger cohort model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the cohort model gains 1 focus point.

name: Reality Anchor
description: Enemy models cannot be summoned within 10" of this model.

name: Roiling Earth
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 3" of this model, the enemy model suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Sturdy
description: This model cannot be pushed.

name: •Breath Taker (★Action)
description: For one round, living enemy models suffer –2 DEF and –2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

name: •Winter Storm (★Action)
description: Enemy models that begin their activations within 10" of this model lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder that activation. Winter Storm lasts for one round.

name: •Hoarfrost (★ Attack)
description: Hoarfrost is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 14/8 arcane attack that causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

name: Defensive Strike
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Blood-Quenched
description: This model gains a cumulative +1 ARM and +1 to its melee damage rolls for each enemy model it destroys with a melee attack during its activation. This bonus lasts for one round.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Killing Spree
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved this model can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.

name: Poltergeist
description: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.

name: Ancient Shroud
description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

name: Dark Prophecy
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy models within 8" lose their essence points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, or be forced for one round.

name: •Grip of Shadows (★Action)
description: This model gains Telemetry for one round. (Other friendly models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.)

name: •Whispers at the Gate (★Action)
description: Remove 1 essence point from each enemy infernal model currently within 5" of this model. Add 1 essence point to each friendly infernal model currently within 5" of this model.

name: •Word of Ruin (★Action)
description: This model gains Master of Ruin for one round. (Other models suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

name: Inquisitor’s Talisman
description: This model begins the game with three power tokens. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.

name: •Chain Lightning (★ Attack)
description: Chain Lightning is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Chain Lightning damage rolls are simultaneous.

name: •Stealth (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth for one round.

name: Power Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 power token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Dismember
description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warbeasts.

name: Reconnaissance (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target friendly warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Pathfinder. Reconnaissance lasts for one turn.

name: Side Step
description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

name: Take Up
description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

name: Finisher
description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.

name: Prey
description: After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

name: Granted: Advance Deployment
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Advance Deployment.

name: Granted: Reposition [3"]
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Quick Work
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack.

name: Granted: Hunter
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit ignore concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

name: Hot Meal
description: This model can use Hot Meal once per game at any time during its activation. Remove all damage from friendly living warrior Faction models within 5" of this model.

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Anchor
description: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Razor]
description: The only warjack that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Razor.

name: Shield Wall
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

name: Marksman
description: When damaging a warjack or warbeast with a ranged attack, choose which column or branch suffers damage.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Blizzard (★Action)
description: Choose a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model. Center a cloud effect template on the chosen model. The template remains centered on the model for one round. If the chosen model is destroyed or removed from play, remove the template from play.

name: •Razor Wind (★Attack)
description: Razor Wind is a RNG SP 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

name: Medicate [d3+1] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

name: Enrage (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.

name: Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Strafing Run
description: This model gains an additional die on ranged attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Crash and Burn
description: When this model is disabled, make a RNG 7, AOE 4, POW 15/10 ranged attack then remove this model from play. Models hit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Drive: Shatter
description: While within 10" of this model, the melee weapons of a warjack under its control gain Shatter. (A weapon with Shatter gains an additional damage die against stationary models.).

name: Fabricated Defense
description: Once per game, during its activation this model can place a Barrier, Fire Pit, Powder Keg, or Spike Trap Defense within 1" of this model. You can not place this defense within 3" of another defense, overlapping a model, obstruction or obstacle."

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Fleet
description: Once per activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to gain +2 SPD that activation.

name: Follow Up
description: When this model slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.

name: Grand Slam
description: This model can make slam power attacks without spending a focus point. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

name: Battle Plan
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: •Desperate Pace [Immortal]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Immortal trooper model. If the model is in range, the models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: •Fight to the Last
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

name: •Wings of Death
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Construct warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Incorporeal for one round. If the model is in range and is a trooper model, the models in its unit also gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: Soul Vessel
description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

name: Alpha Hunter
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make power attacks without being forced. When this model destroys one or more enemy models during its activation, warbeasts in its battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and MAT for one turn.

name: Exorcist
description: While within 10" of this model, enemy models lose Incorporeal.

name: Leadership [Blighted Ogrun]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain Rise.

name: Rise
description: If this model is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.

name: Spiritual Conduit
description: While its Leader is within 10" of this model, when the Leader casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +2 RNG.

name: Unbinding (★Action)
description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: Spontaneous Mutation
description: This model can suffer damage at any time during its activation to gain one of the following special rules for each damage point suffered. This damage cannot be transferred. Each special rule lasts until the start of this model’s next activation.

name: •Warp Strength
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: •Wings
description: This model gains +1 SPD and Flight.

name: •Ashen Veil
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Regeneration [d3]
description: This model can be forced to remove d3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

name: Snacking
description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Exigent
description: Enemy models engaged by a model with Exigent suffer –2 to attack rolls when attacking models without Exigent.

name: Plasma Nimbus
description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to have the attacking model suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

name: Reposition [2"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.

name: Roadblock
description: This model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model loses Roadblock while it is incorporeal or knocked down

name: Repair [1] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

name: Strip (★ Action)
description: This model can make this special action only when B2B with an enemy warjack. The warjack suffers 1 damage point to the column of your choice.

name: Force Mastery
description: This model cannot become knocked down. While in this model's control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

name: •Precision Strike
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.

name: Annoyance
description: Living enemy models within 1" of this model suffer –1 to attack rolls.

name: •Stand Your Ground
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Set Defense for one round. (Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

name: •Special Orders
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Focused Strike
description: When this model damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.

name: Accumulator [Ellowuyr]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Ellowuyr warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Inscrutable
description: Opponents cannot take control of this model.

name: Duelist
description: This model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

name: Riposte
description: When it is missed by an enemy melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic melee attack against the attacking model.

name: Sprint
description: At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, this model can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.

name: Revelations of the Outer Darkness
description: Once per turn, when a friendly Faction warrior within 12" of this model is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending essence, focus, or fury.

name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

name: Field Marshal [Sacred Ward]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: •Harmonious Exaltation (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target this model’s Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

name: Willing Vessel
description: When an infernal master summons a horror and chooses this model to remove from play, the infernal master does not need to spend any essence points to summon the horror.

name: Anathema
description: When this model is summoned, center a cloud effect template on it. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round.  A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the template suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Psycho Static
description: Spells channeled through this model the turn it is summoned suffer –3 RNG.

name: Channeling
description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller can channel spells through it

name: Soul Parasites
description: Living non-soulless enemy models and enemy models with Soul Vessel suffer –2 to their attack rolls while within 4" of this model.

name: Wailing
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells.

name: Soul Claiming
description: When a living enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Soul Void
description: Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from enemy models destroyed within 6" of this model.

name: •Influence (★Attack)
description: Influence is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

name: •Instigate (★Action)
description: While within 5"of this model, friendly large-based and smaller monstrosities gain +2 on attack and damage rolls. Instigate lasts for one turn.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Monstrosity]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Monstrosity within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Agonies
description: Once at any time during its activation, this model can be forced to use one of the following effects:

name: •Gnawing Pain
description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Gnawing Pain lasts for one round.

name: •Maddening
description: Enemy warbeasts currently within 6" of this model gain 1 fury point.

name: •Spiritual Affliction
description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models cannot cast spells. Spiritual Affliction lasts for one round.

name: Apparition
description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

name: •Sigil of Power (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

name: •Black Waters (★Action)
description: While within 3" of this model, models treat open terrain as shallow water and gain Resistance Fire. Black Waters lasts for one round.

name: Tactician
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

name: Soul Taker: Spirit Harvester
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

name: Acid Cloud
description: This model can use Acid Cloud once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models in the template when it is placed or that enter or end their activation in the template suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Bond [Aiakos]
description: If Kharybdis begins the game in Aiakos’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Kharybdis is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Kharybdis is bonded to Aiakos and in his control range, it gains Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Body Snatcher: Heart Eater
description: When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Crucible of Death
description: This model can spend up to three corpse tokens at the start of its activation to gain 1 focus point for each corpse token spent.

name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [5"]
description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Death Industry
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction undead Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within 12" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Blade Rush
description: While making a trample power attack, this model does not stop when it contacts a model with a medium or larger base, an obstacle, or an obstruction. This model makes trample attacks against models regardless of their base size. This model cannot hit models occupying buildings with its trample power attacks.

name: Innate Power
description: Reduce the COST of spells cast by this model by 1.

name: Entropic Presence
description: This model can be forced to gain Master of Ruin once per activation. Entropic Presence lasts for one round. (Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

name: •Heal [d3+3] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+3 damage points from it.

name: •Enliven (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

name: •Tune Up (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction cohort. If the cohort is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the cohort expire, and the cohort gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Insidious Plans
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: •Curse [Horror]
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit. If the target enemy model/unit is in range, friendly horrors gain +2 to attack rolls against it. Curse lasts for one turn.

name: •Shadow
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model. If the target enemy model is in range, when it advances or is placed, after its movement or placement is resolved one friendly non-trooper warrior model within 10" of this model can make a full advance. Shadow lasts for one round.

name: Granted: Spell Ward
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Death Magic
description: During its activation, this model can remove friendly Grunt models in its unit from play to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional melee attack or boost one roll for each model removed. When this model would suffer damage, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any number of those damage points instead, divided as you choose. If you do, this model does not suffer that damage. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Death Magic than it has unmarked damage boxes.

name: •Craft Thrall Rune (★Action)
description: Choose a Risen Grunt in this unit and replace it with a Thrall Warrior solo. Remove the Risen Grunt model from play.

name: Body Snatcher: Stir the Dead
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living model is destroyed within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. At the end of your next Control Phase, remove all corpse tokens from this model and add one Risen Grunt to this unit for each corpse token removed. Place Risen Grunts within 2" on another model in this unit. This unit cannot have more than ten Risen Grunts in play at any time.

name: Created
description: This model does not begin the game in play.

name: •Grave Summons (★Action)
description: When this model uses Grave Summons it can spend any number of soul tokens. For each soul token spent put one friendly Thrall Warrior solo into play anywhere completely within 3" of this model.

name: •Spectral Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: •Soul-Powered
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

name: •Null Magic (★Action)
description: For one round, models cannot cast spells while within 10" of this model.

name: •Power of Death (★Action)
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly undead models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Power of Death lasts for one turn.

name: Flank [Undead]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Undead model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Leadership [Undead]
description: While a friendly Undead is within 10" of this model, it gains Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Passive Necromancy
description: Once per turn when another living warrior model is boxed while within 10" of this model, you can choose to remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a Thrall Warrior model. The Thrall Warrior must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: Channeler
description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.

name: Ionization [5"]
description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 5" of this model, add +2 to the roll.

name: Iron Sentinel
description: While B2B with a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 DEF and ARM and cannot become knocked down.

name: Shifting Sands Stance
description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +2 DEF. If an enemy attack misses it at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved this model can immediately make a full advance. Shifting Sands Stance lasts for one round.

name: Monster Hunter
description: When this model hits a warbeast with an attack, the warbeast suffers d3 + 3 points of damage to the branch of your choice.

name: Ritual Slaughter
description: Once during each of your turns when another friendly Blighted Ogrun model destroys an enemy model with an attack while in this model’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury. This model can spend fury to boost attack and damage rolls on spells cast as a result of Ritual Slaughter.

name: Espionage (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target enemy Leader model. If the enemy Leader is in range, one friendly faction model within 8" of this model can immediately advance 3".

name: Mark Target
description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to ranged attack rolls against enemy models within 5" of this model and in its LOS.

name: Gifts of Annihilation

description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Treewalker. (A model with Treewalker ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, a model with Treewalker gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.)

name: Habitable [Bunker]
description:
Small- and medium-based non-Leader warrior models can enter this building through a door on the lower level. A model/unit ending its Normal Movement within 1" of the door can choose to enter this building.  

Models entering this building can be placed on either the lower or upper levels. Models in a unit occupying this building can be placed on either floor or both. There can be up to five small-based models or three medium-based models on each floor. There must be room for a model’s base for it to be placed on the top floor.

name: Fortified Walls
description: Models cannot be targeted and do not suffer blast damage while occupying the lower level of this terrain feature.

name: Top Floor [Bunker]
description: The upper level of this building is considered to be elevated terrain.

name: Movement Inside the Bunker
description: Models/units can use their Normal Movement to be placed on the top floor if they were previously on the lower floor or to be placed on the lower floor if they were on the top floor. Units using their Normal Movement to be placed are considered to have moved. Models cannot otherwise move or be placed while occupying inside the building.

name: Out of Action
description: While occupying this building models/units cannot contest, control, hold, or secure flags, objectives, or zones.

name: •Dark Unraveling
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 corpse token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Grave Secrets
description: If this model is in its Leader’s control range during your Control Phase, its Leader can spend corpse tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

name: Rattle Bones
description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens and is in its Leader’s control range, its Leader can channel spells through it.

name: War Weaver
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

name: Fate Blessed
description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack or damage roll during its activation while in this model’s control range, this model can spend 1 focus or fury point to allow the model to reroll that roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fate Blessed.

name: Bond [Asphyxious]
description: If Cankerworm begins the game in Asphyxious’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Cankerworm is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Asphyxious and in his control range, Cankerworm gains Reposition [5"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

name: Salvage Harvester
description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3+3 damage points from this model.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Temptations of Fate
description: While this model is within 3" of its warcaster, the warcaster gains Sucker!. (If a model with Sucker! is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.)

name: Acrobatics
description: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.

name: Field Marshal [Sprint]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: •Defensive Measures (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Bond [Stryker]
description: If Ol’ Rowdy begins the game in Stryker’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ol’ Rowdy is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Ol’ Rowdy is bonded to Stryker and in his control range, both models gain +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.

name: Defense Formation
description: While in this model’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in this model's battlegroup with an extra-large base or smaller gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake.

name: Reciprocate
description: When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack targeting the attacking model.

name: Leadership [Gun Mages]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Gun Mage models gain Reciprocate.

name: Field Marshal [Prowl]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Prowl.

name: Veteran Leader [Assault Strider]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Assault Strider models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Gatorman]
description: This model and friendly Gatorman models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Oath of Vengeance [Undead]
description: This model gains +2 to its attack and damage rolls against Undead models.

name: •Money Shot
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 RAT and +2 to its ranged damage rolls for one turn.

name: Activate Halfjack
description: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Halfjack solo into play within 1" of this model if there are fewer than three Halfjacks in play in Darius’ battlegroup.

name: Companion [Captain E. Dominic Darius]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Captain E. Dominic Darius. If Darius is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Darius’ battlegroup. Place all three Halfjacks in play at the start of the game.

name: Prime Mine (★Action)
description: Replace this model with a mine marker. You can have up to three mine markers in play at any time. After resolving continuous effects during your Maintenance Phase, you can detonate any number of friendly mine markers. Models within 3" of a mine marker suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll, then the mine marker is removed from the table.

name: Repair [1] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

name: Reserve Accumulator
description: Once per turn during your Control Phase after replenishing focus, if this model is within 5" of its controlling Leader, the Leader can gain 1 focus point. If the Leader gains a focus point, roll a d6. On the roll of 1 or 2, this model loses the Reserve Accumulator special rule for the rest of the game.

name: Sigil of Power (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

name: Field Marshal [Black Penny]
description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Black Penny. [Attacks made with weapons with Black Penny ignore the target in melee DEF bonus.]

name: Fortune Hunter
description: This model gains an additional die on its attack and damage rolls against character models.

name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

name: Iron Horse
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model's control range gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. Additionally, warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model’s control range gain +2 SPD when resolving charges. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Field Marshal [True Sight]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain True Sight.

name: Guns Blazing
description: This model can use Guns Blazing once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can make one additional ranged attack during this unit’s Combat Action.

name: •At All Costs
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: •Press the Advantage
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Swift Hunter for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Battle Configuration [Sky Stormer or Ground Assault]
description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose a configuration for this model to take: Sky Stormer or Ground Assault. Use that configuration’s stats and rules for one round.

name: Field Marshal [Steady & Sturdy]
description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup cannot become knocked down or pushed.

name: Field Marshal [Gang Fighter]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Gang Fighter. (When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.)

name: Call to Sacrifice [Revenant]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Revenant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Veteran Leader [Revenant]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Revenant models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Veteran Leader [Devil Dog]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Devil Dog models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Elite Cadre [Brineblood Marauder Warrior]
description: Friendly non-Leader Faction warrior models gain Undead.

name: Earthworks
description: After deployment but before the first turn, place three Trapdoor markers within 24" of the rear edge of your Deployment Zone and not with 5" of each other.

name: Field Marshal [Ambush and Tunnel Ambush]
description: Medium based cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. (When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.)

name: Brute Force
description: Each turn, the first medium based cohort model in this model’s battlegroup to ambush gains Sneak Attack until the end of the turn. (The turn a model with Sneak Attack ambushes, it gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against models within 5".)

name: Arcane Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 focus or fury point. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Alcohol-Fueled
description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Temperamental and is removed from play.

name: Temperamental
description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

name: Channeler [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
description: While this model is in Wurmwood, Tree of Fate’s control range, Wurmwood can channel spells through it.

name: Fury-Bound
description: While in Wurmwood’s control range, this model can spend fury points on Wurmwood to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each fury point spent.

name: Companion [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Wurmwood, Tree of Fate. If Wurmwood is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Wurmwood’s battlegroup. This model is also attached to Wurmwood. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it.

name: Combustion (★ Attack)
description: This attack does not need a target. Other models within 2" of this model suffer a POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Combustion damage is simultaneous. This model can make additional melee attacks after making this special attack.

name: Granted: Bulldoze
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Bulldoze. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

name: Granted: Sacred Ward
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Fury Bank
description: While this model is in a friendly Faction warlock’s control range during the warlock’s activation, the warlock can move fury points from itself to this model at any time. This model can have up to 3 fury points at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend fury points to boost one attack or damage roll for each fury point spent.

name: Power of the Stones
description: During your Control Phase, this model can leech fury from friendly Faction construct warbeasts within 10" of it.

name: Leadership [Paladin]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladin models gain Girded.

name: Phantasmal Field
description: This model gains +1 DEF against ranged and arcane attack rolls for each focus point on it.

name: Bond [Xekaar]
description: If Chiron begins the game in Xekaar’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Chiron is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Chiron is bonded to Xekaar and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

name: Leadership [Basilisks]
description: When another friendly Basilisk model ends its activation while within 10" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that model.

name: •Passage (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by non-magical ranged attacks. Passage lasts for one round.

name: •Battle (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it gains +2 to its damage rolls. Battle lasts for one turn.

name: Hymn
description: When a model in this unit performs a Hymn special action, choose a hymn. Each activation, all models in this unit performing a hymn must perform the same one. A model can only be affected by one hymn at any time.

name: •Shielding (★Action)
description: RNG 5.  Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by enemy spells. Shielding lasts for one round.

name: Homicidal Maniac
description: If there are no models in this model’s melee range after resolving a basic melee attack in which this model destroyed one or more enemy models, this model can advance up to 1".

name: Tunnel Ambush
description: When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.

name: Foul Stench
description: While within 5" of this model, living enemy warbeasts suffer –1 FURY and THR.

name: Time Stutter
description: Once per turn, when one or more of this model’s aspects are crippled by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Realignment
description: This model can use Realignment once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can reroll failed attack rolls this turn. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Realignment.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Mechanikally Adept
description: This model can target non-Faction models with Repair special actions.

name: Butcher's Bill
description: If one or more friendly warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in this model's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Activate Rocket Turret
description: Once per turn at any time during Brisbane’s activation, you can place a Rocket Turret anywhere completely within 3" of him unless he already has a Rocket Turret in play. The Rocket Turret cannot activate the turn it is put into play.

name: Desperate Pace [Trencher] (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trencher trooper model. If the model is in range,  models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Rocket Pack
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one focus point to use Rocket Pack. During that activation, this model gains +2 SPD and Flight.

name: Companion [Colonel Brisbane]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Colonel Markus "Siege" Brisbane. If Brisbane is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Brisbane’s battlegroup.

name: Pack It Up
description: If this model is in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can remove it from play.

name: Sentry Fire
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed within 8" of this model, this model can immediately make one basic ranged attack targeting that model.

name: Turret
description: This model cannot advance. This model cannot become knocked down or be pushed and is automatically hit by melee attacks. This model does not suffer blast damage.

name: Acid Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Corrosion for one round.

name: Heat Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Fire for one round.

name: Magical Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Damage Type Magical for one round.

name: Arcane Accumulator
description: When another model in this model’s control range casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. After this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each power token with 1 focus point.

name: Overpower
description: After this model replenishes its focus during your Control Phase but before it allocates focus, this model can spend focus to increase its control range for one round by 2" for each focus point spent.

name: Foxhole Buddy
description: While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, this model gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.

name: Bond [Siege]
description: If Triumph begins the game in Siege’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Triumph is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Triumph is bonded to Siege and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Chain Attack: Flash
description: If this model hits the same target with both its initial melee attacks, after resolving the attacks you can immediately place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Reversal
description: When a model misses this model with a charge or a power attack, the attacking model becomes knocked down.

name: Snap Strike
description: This model can make one additional attack with each melee weapon for each focus or fury point spent to make additional attacks.

name: Mission Objective
description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Mission Objective. When it does, choose an enemy model/unit in this model’s LOS. This activation, models in this unit gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against the chosen model/unit.

name: Granted: Reposition [2"]
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [2"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [2"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.)

name: Paint Target (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target enemy model. If the model is within range, it suffers Flare. (A model suffering Flare loses Stealth and suffers  –2 DEF for one turn.)

name: Monkey Bite
description: While in melee with this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to melee attack rolls.

name: Open Bar
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly living Faction models with a large or smaller base gain Stumbling Drunk.

name: Leadership [Faction Warrior Models]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly faction warrior models gain Prowl.

name: Hide on Bush
description: When this model ends its activation with concealment, it gains Admonition for one round. (When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of a model with Admonition, the model with Admonition can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.)

name: Self-Propelled
description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

name: Explosive Decomposition
description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

name: Inconsequential
description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

name: Battle-Driven
description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gains +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

name: Granted: Dual Shot
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)

name: All-Terrain (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Granted: Dodge
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: •Rituals of Shadow (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly horror. If the horror was in range, it gains 1 essence point.

name: •Touch of Darkness (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly living soulless model. If that model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Granted: Self-Sacrifice
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Self-Sacrifice. (If a model with Self-Sacrifice is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in its unit within 3" of the model with Self-Sacrifice to be destroyed and the model with Self-Sacrifice removes 1 damage point.)

name: •Annihilation (★Attack)
description: Annihilation is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 10/10 arcane attack. Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: •Knowledge of the Damned
description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

name: Future Sight
description: This model can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.

name: Craft Talisman (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

name: Primal Magic
description: This model can be forced to cast the animus of any friendly Faction warbeast within 5" of it as if the animus were its own.

name: Charmer
description: When a friendly warbeast would frenzy in this model’s control range, instead of frenzying the warbeast can forfeit its activation.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Skarath]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Skarath.

name: Bond [Dahlia Hallyr]
description: Skarath begins the game in Dahlia Hallyr’s battlegroup and is bonded to her. Skarath is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Skarath is bonded to Dahlia and in her control range, Skarath gains an additional die on attack rolls against models in Hallyr’s control range.

name: Take Down
description: Models disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by this model are removed from play.

name: •Death Ride (★Action)
description: Friendly Faction undead models activating within 5" of this model gain +1" movement when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Death Ride lasts for one turn.

name: •Hellfire (★Attack)
description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 arcane attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: •Invocation of Darkest Night (★Action)
description: This model gains Mortal Fear. Invocation of Darkest Night lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer -2 to damage rolls.)

name: Leadership [Dawnguard Destors]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dawnguard Destor models gain Tough and Steady.

name: Extended Fire
description: This model can use Extended Fire once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, the ranged weapons of models in this unit gain Snipe. (An attack with a weapon with Snipe gains +3 RNG.)

name: •Deathly Strike
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Build Up Power
description: If this model advances during its Normal Movement, it gains 3 power tokens. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Coordinated Movement
description: Friendly models can ignore this model when determining LOS and can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past it.

name: Psycho Matrix
description: This model can spend power tokens to use the following effects:

name: •Force Shield
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one power token to gain Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

name: •Telekinetic Wave
description: When this model ends its Normal Movement, it can spend one power token to use Telekinetic Wave. When it does so, choose one non-huge-based friendly Faction Cohort model within 2" of it. You can place the chosen model any where completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Telekinetic Wave only once per turn.

name: Flank [friendly Faction Cohort model]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Never Ending Pile
description: At the start of this model’s activation, if it does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token.

name: Special Delivery
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove any number of corpse tokens and place them on a friendly model that can gain corpse tokens within 5" of it.

name: Warmth of the Grave
description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 4" of this model +1" for each corpse token on this model.

name: Cannibal Magic
description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it can spend a corpse token to suffer 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

name: Soul Taker: Collector
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: Skulls of Hate
description: This model is a spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model gains 1 soul token for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

name: •Necrotheurgy
description: Once during its activation this model can spend a soul token to cast a spell without spending focus.

name: •Soul Generator
description: At the start of this model’s activation, you can spend soul tokens on this model to give it 1 focus point for each token spent.

name: •Devour Soul
description: At any time during its activation this model can spend one soul token to remove d3 damage.

name: •Necromancy
description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, it can spend focus points to cast its controller’s spells. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

name: Hate Fueled

(At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Vent Steam
description: This model can use Vent Steam once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Living and undead models in the template when it is placed suffer an unboostable POW 12 damage roll.

name: Bond [Butcher]
description: If Ruin begins the game in Butcher’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ruin is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Ruin is bonded to Butcher and in his control range, it gains Boundless Charge. (During its activation, a model with Boundless Charge can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges.)

name: Spectral Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Field Marshal [Flank Man-O-War]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Flank [Man-O-War]. (When a model with Flank [Man-O-War] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Man-O-War model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Storm’s Embrace
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain concealment.

name: Arcane Pattern Array
description: When another model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Toad Licker
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following toad effects. Toad effects last for one round.

name: •Death Crazed
description: This model gains Berserk and Last Word. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

name: •Blood Sweats
description: This model gains +2 ARM. If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

name: •Psychonaut
description: This model gains Eyeless Sight and Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Strange Growth
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Serenity
description: At the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching, you can remove 1 fury point from a friendly Faction warbeast within 1" of this model.

name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Prowl]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Prowl.

name: Arcane Secrets (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target this model’s Leader. If the Leader is in range, it gains an additional die on arcane  attack rolls and magical damage rolls for the next spell it casts. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Arcane Secrets lasts for one turn.

name: Arcane Consumption
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points and this model can remove d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: •Seasoning the Sauce (★Action)
description: This model gains d3 corpse tokens.

name: •Spectral Lash (★Attack)
description: Spectral Lash is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Spectral Lash’s point of origin.

name: •Hand of Glory (★ Attack)
description: Hand of Glory is a RNG 7 arcane attack. Target enemy model hit becomes stationary for one round.

name: Eruption of Flies
description: When this model suffers damage as a result of an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can target the attacking model with a SP 8, POW 14 ranged attack that causes corrosion damage. This attack ignores the firing into melee penalty. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Carnivorous Swarm
description: When this model is disabled, center a cloud effect template on it, then remove this model from play. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending their activation in the template suffer 1 point of corrosion damage

name: •Sacrificial Strike (★Action)
description: RNG 12. Target a model in this model’s LOS. If that model is in range, remove one friendly Faction trooper model within 1" of this model from play. The target model suffers an unboostable magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the removed model.

name: Focus Matrix
description: This model can allocate focus points during its activation. Once per turn during its activation, you can remove focus points from warjacks in this model’s battlegroup that are in its control range and give those focus points to this model. This model cannot have more focus points than its ARC as a result of Focus Matrix.

description: Friendly Bloodgorgers models in this army gain Berserk

name: Veteran Leader [Pyg]
description: While within 10" of this model, other Pyg models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Pain Maddened
description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, it gains +2 SPD for one round.

name: Bond [Kromac]

(When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •Murderous
description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.

name: •Snacking
description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Experimental Brainspike

name: Paralyzing Gaze
