description: Immediately after this model resolves a melee attack in which it destroys one or more living models, it can end its activation and remove d3 damage points.

name: Reinforced
description: This model always has cover.

name: Spell Vortex
description: If an enemy model cast a spell in this model’s control range last turn, this model can cast one spell without spending focus during its activation this turn.

name: •Entropic Force
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Entropic Force lasts for one round.

name: Primordial Rage
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can advance up to 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

name: Primordial Resillience
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Primordial Warding
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Bone Working
description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

name: Buzzing Swarm
description: While within 2" of this model, models gain concealment. Additionally, while within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Imperishable Conviction
description: When a friendly Faction model in its control range is destroyed by an enemy attack, this model can remove 1 damage point.

name: Paragon of the Faith
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar warrior models gain Tough.

name: Blessed Wards
description: This model gains +3 ARM against damage rolls made by Infernal or undead models.

name: Eye of Menoth
description: While in this model’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

name: •Bone Working
description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

name: Grave Digger (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Faction model. If the model is in range, it becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover and Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: I Found One! (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model with a Body Snatcher special rule. If the model is in range and does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token. A model can only be targeted by I Found One once per turn.

name: Undertaker
description: This model gains an additional die on attack and damage rolls against undead models.

name: Cautious Advance
description:
This model can use Cautious Advance once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, this unit must make a full advance as its Normal Movement, then each model in the unit performs the Dig In special action and can take their Combat
Actions.

name: Drive: Foxhole Buddy
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Foxhole Buddy. (While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, a model with Fox Hole Buddy gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.)

name: Leadership [Wolf Sworn]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Wolf Sworn models gain Prowl and Side Step.

name: Mage Ward
description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models gain Magic Resistance. (When this model is targeted by an arcane attack roll, roll one additional die. Discard the highest die of each roll).

name: Immovable Object
description: This model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

name: Master Infernalist
description: This model is not an infernal master or Leader but has all the rules of an infernal master except it does not have a feat and cannot summon horrors. This model can have only light or lesser horrors in its battlegroup and must start with one in it's battlegroup at the begining of the game. This model replenishes its essence without sacrificing a model during its Control Phase.

name: Mischief
description: When an enemy warjack or battle engine begins its activation B2B with this model, roll a d3. On a roll of 1, the warjack or battle engine suffers –2 SPD that activation. On a 2, it suffers –2 to attack rolls that activation. On a 3, it suffers –2 to damage rolls that activation.

name: •Call of Defiance
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models do not lose Tough while knocked down. Call of Defiance lasts for one round.

name: Snow-Wreathed
description: This model has concealment.

name: Primal Rage
description: Once per turn, when this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.

name: •Desperate Pace [Trollkin]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trollkin trooper model. If the model is in range, models inits unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Leadership [Grotesques]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Grotesques models gain Stealth.

name: Secured Perimeter [6"]
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF while within 6" of this model.

name: Habitable [Guard Tower]
description:
Small and medium-based units and solos can enter this building through a door on the lower level. A model/unit ending its Normal Movement within 1" of the door can choose to enter this building.
 
Models entering this building can be placed on either the lower or upper levels. Models in a unit occupying this building can placed on either floor or both. There can be up to five small-based models or three medium-based models on each floor. There must be room for a model’s base for it to be placed on either floor.

name: Movement Inside the Guard Tower
description: Models/units can use their Normal Movement to be placed on the top floor if they were previously on the lower floor or to be placed on the lower floor if they were on the top floor. Units using their Normal Movement to be placed are considered to have moved. Models cannot otherwise move or be placed while inside the building.

name: Top Floor [Guard Tower]
description: The upper level of this building is considered to be elevated terrain. Additionally, arcane and ranged attacks made by models on the top floor gain +4 RNG.

name: Hollow Ward
description: While within 4" of this model, friendly horrors gain +2 ARM against melee attack damage rolls made by construct, soulless, or undead models.

name: Unsummonable
description: This model cannot be summoned.

name: Soul Claiming
description: When a living non-soulless enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Catastrophic Explosion
description: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Then remove this model from play.

name: Binge Drinking
description: This model can use Binge Drinking once per game at any time during its activation. This model becomes knocked down.

name: Hangover
description: The first time this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it removes all damage and becomes knocked down.

name: Soul Taker: Body Count
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

name: Time Projection
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model can allocate focus points to warjacks in its control range that are in Haley Prime’s battlegroup. This model can channel spells through warjacks in Haley Prime’s battlegroup that have the Arc Node advantage and are in this model’s control range.

name: Raw Talent
description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls.

name: Reinforcements [Rhul Guard]
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Rhulic Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Periscope
description: This model can use Periscope once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one turn.

name: Blazing Wrath
description: This model can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without spending focus or being forced.

name: Bond [Feora]
description: If Hand of Judgment begins the game in Feora’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hand of Judgment is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Hand of Judgment is bonded to Feora and in her control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

name: •Strength of Death
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Direct Spirits
description: When a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed within 10" of this model and generates a soul token, you choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model’s soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 10" of this model.

name: Ashen Veil
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Soul Ravager
description: When this model destroys an enemy model with an attack, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models and the destroyed model is removed from play.

name: Soul Shatter
description: Once per turn, when a non-soulless living enemy model advances and ends is movement or is placed within 4" of this model, this model can spend 1 essence point. When it does the living model gains Soulless for the rest of the game and this model's Leader gains its soul token.

name: Invocations of Dust
description: When a friendly undead non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can spend 1 focus point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model.

name: Beer Wagon
description: While within 5" of this model, friendly Northkin warbeasts and warrior models gain Stumbling Drunk. Beer Wagon lasts for one round. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Coordinated Barrage
description: This model can make ranged attacks targeting enemy models suffering Flare, ignoring RNG and LOS.

name: Forward Deployment
description: This model can be deployed up to 8" beyond your deployment zone.

name: Danger Close
description: Once per turn during a friendly Faction model’s activation, after an attack or special action that applies Flare to an enemy model is resolved, this model may immediately make a basic ranged attack targeting the enemy model.

name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Veteran Leader [Farrow Valkyries]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Farrow Valkyries gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Tendrils
description: If there are fewer than three Tentacles in this unit in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can put one Tentacle into play within 2" of this model. If this model is destroyed or removed from play, the Tentacles in its unit are removed from play.

name: Carapace Grenades
description: Once per turn when this model is hit by a melee attack, after the attack has been resolved this model can use Carapace Grenades. When it does so, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll. This model loses Carapace Grenades while its S system is crippled.

name: Tunneler
description: This model can forfeit its Normal Movement to be placed anywhere completely within 10" of its current location. Colossal Movement does not apply to this model while resolving this rule. After it has been placed, enemy models within 2" of this model can be pushed up to 3" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

name: Debris Field
description: Enemy models treat open terrain within 4" of this model as rough terrain.

name: Threshing Maw
description: After this model is placed by Tunneler but before pushing enemy models as a result of Tunneler, enemy models within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 melee damage roll.

name: Void Disruptor
description:
The first time each turn each enemy warjack or monstrosity ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 focus. The first time each turn each enemy horrors ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 essence. The first time each turn each enemy warbeast ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it gains 1 fury.

While the Hellraker has two functional Void Disruptors, enemy cohorts are affected by this ability within 6" rather than 3".

name: Weapons Platform
description: As long as a model has two options that include Weapons Platform special rule this model gains the Gunfighter advantage.

description: Once per turn, when its controller channels a spell through this model, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

description: If Hemera begins the game in Issyria’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hemera is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Hemera is bonded to Issyria and in her control range, Issyria can upkeep one spell without spending focus.

name: Guidance (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Oracular Vision.

name: Field Marshal [Unstoppable]
description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Unstoppable.

description: When this model boxes a living enemy warrior model with a melee attack, you can place a Wrack into play completely within 4" of this model. If you do, remove the boxed model from play.

name: Witch Hound
description: When an enemy model hits one or more models in this model’s battlegroup with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3" and make one basic attack.

name: Fiery Blast
description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 14 blast fire damage roll.

name: Suffering’s Prayer
description:
This model begins the game with 1 focus point. During your Control Phase, this model receives 1 focus point if it does not have any. This model cannot have more than 1 focus point at any time. While this model has a focus point, it cannot be damaged by ranged attacks. During a friendly Faction warcaster’s activation, it can remove 1 focus point from this model in its control range and gain that focus point. Each warcaster can do this only once per turn. When a focus point is removed from this model, roll a d6. On a 1 or 2, this model explodes with the same effect as Fiery Blast and is removed from
play.

name: Battle Plan
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.

name: Brother’s Keeper [Exemplar]
description: While  within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar models cannot become knocked down or stationary.

name: •Desperate Pace [small- or medium-based Exemplar]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly small- or medium-based Exemplar trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Leadership [Paladins of the Order of the Wall]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladins of the Order of the Wall gain Righteous Vengeance.

name: Stone-and-Mortar Stance
description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +3 ARM. The affected model cannot become knocked down. Stone-and-Mortar Stance lasts for one round.

name: Treasure Hunter
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, friendly models within 8" of it gain Pathfinder.

name: Claim Jumper
description: Ignore enemy models within 5" of this model when determining if an area or objective is contested.

name: Greedy
description: This model can secure or hold any objective regardless of its model type.

name: Revenant [Hoard]
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, it gains +3 DEF and ARM. Additionally, during your Control Phase remove d3+3 damage points from this model if it is securing an area or holding an objective.

name: Raider's Curse
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, enemy models within 5" of this model suffer –2 ARM and lose Tough.

name: Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Scroll Bearer
description: This model can use one of the following scrolls at any time during its activation while within 1" of Hoarluk. Each scroll can be used only once per game.

name: •Scroll of the Call of Troqal
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, each warbeast in his battlegroup can gain 0 fury when forced to use its animus instead of gaining fury points equal to the COST of the animus. Scroll of the Call of Troqal lasts for one turn.

name: •Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, enemy models pay double the focus or fury point cost to cast or upkeep spells. Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi lasts for one round.

name: •Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur lasts for one turn.

name: Prod
description: When a warbeast in this model’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can force the warbeast to advance up to 2".

name: Scroll of the Will of Balasar
description: This model can use Scroll of the Will of Balasar once per game when a warbeast frenzies in its control range. This model’s controller chooses the warbeast’s frenzy target.

name: Sniper
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Granted: Snap Fire
description: While this model is in play the ranged weapons of models in its unit gain Snap Fire. (When a model destroys one or more enemy models with a weapon with Snap Fire during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model can make one basic ranged attack with the same weapon. Attacks gained from Snap Fire cannot generate additional attacks from Snap Fire.)

name: Prayers
description: At the start of this unit's activation, choose one of the following special rules:

name: •Fervor
description: Models in this unit gain +2 to damage rolls this activation.

name: •Path of Flames
description: Models in this unit gain Resistance: Fire for one round.

name: •Warding
description: Models in this unit cannot be trargeted by enemy spells for one round.

name: Greater Destiny
description: This model can use Greater Destiny once per game at the start of its unit’s activation. Immediately return all Grunts to this unit that were destroyed during your opponent’s last turn to play. Place them within 2" of this model. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Holy Monolith
description: When one or more other models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gain +4 ARM for one turn.

name: Call to Sacrifice [Holy Zealot]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Holy Zealot trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Burnt Meat
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without being forced.

name: Bond [Doomshaper]
description: If Mulg begins the game in Doomshaper’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Mulg is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Mulg is bonded to Doomshaper, it gains +1 FURY.

If it is hit by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Field Marshal [Resistance: Fire]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Resistance: Fire.

name: Hell Marked
description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

name: Orgoth Monstrosity
description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in any Orgoth warcaster's battlegroup. An Orgoth warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. An Orgoth warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Orgoth monstrosity. description: Affected models gain Tree Walker for one round. (A model with Treewalker ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, this model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.)

name: •Desperate Pace [Small-Based Liegemen]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly small based Liegemen trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Veteran Leader [Liegemen]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Liegemen models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Field Marshal [Arcane Ammunition]
description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Damage Type: Magical.

name: Range Amplifier
description: When this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.

name: Dark Blessing
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to gain +3 DEF. Dark Blessing lasts for one round.

name: Veteran Leader [Steelback]
description: While within 10" of this model, Steelback models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Journeyman Warcaster
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one warjack in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Accumulator [Storm Legion warrior]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Storm Legion warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Bond (Beat Back)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Beat Back. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.)

name: Bond (Retaliatory Strike)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Bond (Guard Dog)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Guard Dog. (While a model with Guard Dog is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.)

name: Secondary Neural Coupling
description: Remove 1 damage point from this model at the start of each of its activations.

name: Launch Drone Servitor
description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Drone Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model if you do not pesently have two Drone Servitor in play.

name: Power Surge (★Attack)
description: This attack does not need a target. Each enemy model within 3" of this model or 1" of a Drone Servitor is automatically hit and suffers a POW 12 electrical damage roll. Energy Pulse damage rolls are simultaneous. After a Power Surge attack, this model can make additional melee attacks.

name: Tempest Anchor
description: Once per turn, at any time during its activation this model can advance up to 3" directly towards a friendly Drone Servitor, which is then destroyed.

name: Galvanic Strike (★Action)
description: Target  friendly Drone within 8" of this model is slammed D6" in a direction of your choice. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14

name: Bond [Tanith]
description: If Loki begins the game in Tanith’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Loki is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Loki is bonded to Tanith and in her control range, he gains Unstoppable.

name: •Hunter
description: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

name: Vampiric Harvest
description: When a living enemy model is destroyed in this model’s control range, a model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can remove 1 damage point.

name: Field Marshal [Future Sight]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Future Sight.

name: Elite Cadre [Bloodrunners]
description: Friendly Bloodrunner models gain Unstoppable.

name: Overload
description: Once per activation, you can roll one to three dice. This model gains a bonus to its melee attack damage rolls equal to the total of that roll. Then roll the same dice again. This model suffers damage equal to the total of that roll. This model cannot spend a focus point to reduce this damage. This bonus expires at the end of this model’s activation.

name: Soul Taker: Exhumator
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

name: Field Marshal [Arcane Vortex]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Arcane Vortex.

name: Body Snatcher: Trophy Hunter
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. It gains the following abilities based on the number of corpse tokens it has:

name: •1 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least one corpse token, enemy models within 10" and LOS lose Stealth.

name: •3 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least three corpse tokens, Lord of the Hunt gains Hunter and its Thrown Javelin becomes ROF 2. (A model with Hunter ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.)

name: •5 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least five corpse tokens it gains Hunt Eternal. (When a model with Hunt Eternal is disabled, remove all corpse tokens and damage from it; it is no longer disabled.)

name: •Payday
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain boosted melee attack rolls and Overtake for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •Walk It Off
description: RNG 10. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, continuous effects, knockdown, and stationary on the affected models immediately expire.

name: Vampiric Reaving
description: This model can reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed in its control range if it is closer to the warbeast than all other models that could reave its fury.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Warbeast in This Model’s Battlegroup]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal warbeast in this model’s battlegroup within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Shapeshifter
description: This model does not begin the game in play. When a friendly Marked model is disabled by an enemy attack or as the result of a continuous effect, this model can immediately  replace it. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that entered play this turn or that already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When this model replaces a disabled model, this model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When this model is destroyed, remove it from play.

name: Leadership [Lupine Shifted]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Lupine Shifted models gain Jump.

name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Run & Gun.

name: Warping Winds
description: When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.

name: Ill-Gotten Relics
description: This model can use one of the following relics at any time during its activation.

name: •Effigy of War
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit was in range, it gains Relentless Charge this turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: •Shimmering Visage
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in RNG, it gains Dodge. Shimmering Visage lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: •Tome of Living Shade
description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 RNG on their ranged and arcane attacks. Tome of Living Shade lasts for one round.

name: •Wilting Horn
description: While within 10" of this model, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of this model, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Wilting Horn lasts for one round.

name: Applied Knowledge (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warrior model. If the model is in range, when it damages a warjack or warbeast with an attack, you choose which column or branch suffers the damage. Applied Knowledge lasts for one round.

name: First Aid [d3] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: •Wind Barrier (★ Action)
description: Non-magical ranged attacks targeting this model or another model in its unit within 2" of it automatically miss. Wind Barrier lasts for one round.

name: •Wind Burst (★ Attack)
description: Wind Burst is a RNG 10, AOE 3, POW 12/7 arcane attack. After resolving this attack, cloud effects in the spellcaster’s control range expire.

name: •Zephyr (★ Action)
description: Each model in this unit can immediately advance up to 3".

name: •Carrion Hex
description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to cast its animus without being forced.

name: •Butcher's Curse
description: During its activation this model can spend a corpse token to cast one of the spells on its Leaders Card with a cost of 3 or less.This model cannot cast Upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

name: Annihilator
description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls against living models. When a living model is destroyed within 3" of this model, it never generates a soul token.

name: Cask Tapper (★ Action)
description: Place d3 friendly Cask Imp solos into play completely within 4" of this model. Cask Imps cannot activate the turn they are put into play.

name: Vent Fumes
description: While within 3" of this model, living friendly faction models gain Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Parlay (★Action)
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy warrior models cannot target this model or its Leader with attacks. Parlay lasts for one round.

name: Seduction (★Action)
description: Take control of a living enemy non-Leader warrior model within 1" of this model. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic melee attack, then Seduction expires. A model can be affected by Seduction only once per turn.

name: Whelp Shedding
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place a Troll Whelp model into play B2B with this model.

name: Alternate Food Source
description: If this model is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast during the warbeast’s activation, the warbeast can remove d3 damage points. If the warbeast removes damage as a result of Alternate Food Source, remove this model from play.

name: Comfort Food
description: If this model is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast at the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching you can remove this model from play to remove any number of fury points from the warbeast.

name: Spawn Whelps
description: This model does not have to be put into play at the start of the game. When a friendly Faction warbeast is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can put one Troll Whelp that did not begin the game in play into play. You can place this model anywhere completely within 2" of the warbeast.

name: Scroll of Grindar’s Perseverance
description: This model can use Scroll of Grindar’s Perseverance once per game when directly hit by an attack. This model suffers no damage roll from the attack. Declare use of the scroll after this model is hit but before the damage roll is made.

name: Grim Salvation
description: If this model is directly hit by a basic attack made by an enemy model, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Field Marshal [Undead]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Undead.

name: Soul Taker: Spirit Eater
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After leeching during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 fury point.

name: ’Jack Hunter
description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warjacks.

name: Phantom Barrage
description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Phantom Barrage. This activation, models in this unit can ignore cloud effects, forest terrain, and intervening models when determining LOS.

name: Field Marshal [Telemetry]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Telemetry. (Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of a model with Telemetry.)

name: Elite Cadre [Guard Post]
description: Friendly Guard Post models gain Carapace. (Models with Carapace gain +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.)

name: Leadership [Gun Mage]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Gun Mage models gain Head Shot.

name: Field Marshal [Evasive]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Evasive.

name: Gatecrasher
description: If this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models during its activation, at any time during this model's activation it can be placed completely within 5" of its current location then its activation ends.

name: Ionization [10"]
description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 10" of this model, add +2 to the roll.

name: Combat Engineer
description: This model gains an additional die on its damage rolls against buildings and structures.

name: Time Walker
description:
At any time during this model's activation, it can spend 2 focus points to return Haley Past or Haley Future to play. Place that model completely within 2" of this model. The returned model gains a number of focus points equal to its ARC and cannot activate this turn.

After this model replenishes its focus points during your Control Phase, it can spend 2 focus points each to keep Haley Past and/or Haley Future in play. If it does not, that model is removed from the table.

name: Reiteration
description: This model can cast any spell cast by another friendly Haley model this activation as if it were one of its own spells.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Faction warrior]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Faction warrior model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Bond [Makeda]
description: If Molik Karn begins the game in Makeda’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Molik Karn is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While bonded to Makeda and in her control range, Molik Karn gains Side Step. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.)

name: Intuition
description: When an enemy model targets this model with an attack and the attack roll results in a hit, you can immediately force this model to cause the enemy model to reroll the attack roll.

name: Flank [Reptile Hound]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Reptile Hound, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Bond [Xerxis]
description: If Tiberion begins the game in Xerxis’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Tiberion is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Tiberion is bonded to Xerxis and in his control range, it gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved it can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Bullheaded
description: When this model frenzies, if it would charge a model, it targets that model with a slam power attack instead. If it cannot, it frenzies normally.

name: Slammer
description: This model can make slam power attacks without being forced. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

name: •Cradle Song (★Action)
description: When a living enemy model ends its activation within 5" of this model, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round. Cradle Song lasts for one round.

name: •Something Wicked (★ Action)
description: While within 8" of this model, Monkeys gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and Killing Spree. Something Wicked lasts for turn activation. (When a model with Killing Spree destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved, it can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.)

name: Field Marshal [Blazing Wrath]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Blazing Wrath. (A model with Blazing Wrath can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without spending focus of being forced.)

name: Independent Warjack
description: This model cannot be part of battlegroup or be 'jack marshaled. During the focus allocation step of your Control Phase, this model gains 3 focus points.

name: Arcane Machinery
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. Arcane Machinery effects last for one round.

name: •Disengage Safety
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Berserk. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.)

name: •Ignite Thrusters
description: This model gains +2 SPD, Flight, and Flame Trail. (When a model with Flame Trail advances into B2B contact with an enemy model during its activation, the enemy model suffers the Fire continuous effect.)

name: •Telescoping Shields
description: This model gains +2 ARM. Additionally, this model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model does not provide cover while it is incorporeal or knocked down.

name: The Button
description: This model can use The Button once per game at the start of its activation. This model gains the benefits of all of its Arcane Machinery effects this activation.

name: Smoke Launchers
description: This model can use Smoke Launchers once per activation at any time. Place one cloud effect template completely within within 5" of this model. The template remains in play for one round.

name: Granted: Quick Work
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Quick Work. (When a model with Quick Work destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model with Quick Work can make one basic ranged attack.)

name: Support Fire
description: This model can use Support Fire once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)

name: Bond of Brotherhood
description: This model can use Bond of Brotherhood once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. For one round, when a model in this unit is damaged by an enemy attack, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any amount of that damage instead, divided as you choose. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Bond of Brotherhood than it has unmarked damage boxes.

name: Granted: Vengeance
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: •Desperate Pace [Man-O-War]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Man-O-War trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Powder Stores
description: This model can use Powder Stores once per game at anytime during its unit’s activation. That activation, other models in this unit gain +2 to their ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Granted: Resistance: Blast
description: This unit gains Resistance: Blast.

name: Granted: Stumbling Drunk
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Last Call
description: This model can use Last Call once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Arms Caddy
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation and while within 5" of Mr. Clogg, Gearhart can use Arms Caddy. Replace his ranged weapon with one of the weapons on Mr. Clogg’s card. Gearhart keeps that weapon until he uses Arms Caddy again.

name: •Bloody Well Done!
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains an additional die on each model’s first non-spray ranged attack roll this turn.

name: •Give ’Em What For!
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reciprocate for one round. (When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved a model with Reciprocate can make one basic ranged attack against the attacking model.)

name: Companion [Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart. If Gearhart is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Gearhart’s battlegroup.

name: Johnny on the Spot (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target Gearhart. If Gearhart is in range, he immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack.

name: Non-Combatant
description: This model cannot make attacks.

name: Blood Trade
description: This model can upkeep spells by suffering 1 damage point per spell instead of spending focus or fury points.

name: Field Marshal [Pain Response]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Pain Response. (While damaged, a model with Pain Response can charge and make power attacks without being forced.)

name: Flagellant
description: Friendly models can target this model with attacks. This model is automatically hit by melee attacks made by friendly models.

name: Rites of Suffering
description: When this model suffers damage from an attack, it gains one blood token. For each blood token on this model, it gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls. This model can have up to five blood tokens at any time. Remove all blood tokens from this model at the start of your Control Phase.

name: Double Powder Ration
description: This model can use Double Powder Ration once per game at any time during its activation. This turn, ranged attacks made by friendly Privateer models while within 10" of this model gain +2 RNG. Double Powder Ration lasts for one turn.

name: Leadership [Faction Light Warjack]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction light warjack models gain Dodge.

name: •Special Orders
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Field Marshal [Gang Fighter]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Gang Fighter. (When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.)

name: Necrosurgery [d3+1] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly undead Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

name: Elite Cadre [Mechanithrall Swarm]
description: The Thrall Weapons of friendly Mechanithrall Swarm models gain Combo Strike. (Combo Strike (★ Attack) - This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack.)

name: Enliven (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

name: Interface
description: While B2B with this model, a warjack in its battlegroup can spend focus points on this model.

name: Turn Up The Heat
description: This model can use Turn Up the Heat at the start of its activation. This activation, this model gains +2 SPD. At the end of the activation, this model suffers d3 damage points.

name: •Arcane Calibrations
description: Reduce the COST of each spell this model casts this activation by 1 to a minimum of 1.

name: •Ionization [Ctrl]
description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within this model's control range of this model, add +2 to the roll.

name: •Vexing Alignment
description: Increase this model’s control range by 4".

name: Heal [d3] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Bond (Overtake)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Bond (Sprint)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Bond [Baldur]
description: If Megalith begins the game in Baldur’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Megalith is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Megalith is bonded to Baldur and in his control range at the start of Baldur’s activation, Baldur can remove d3 damage points.

name: •Keep On the Move
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Run & Gun for one turn. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

name: •Target Lock
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit in this model’s LOS. While within 10" of this model, friendly warrior models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Target Lock lasts for one turn.

name: Curse [Bone Grinder]
description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Bone Grinder gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

name: Body Snatcher: Gibbet
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token if it does not already have one. This model cannot have more than one corpse token at any time. This model begins the game with one corpse token.

name: Gallows Fruit
description: During a friendly Faction warcaster’s activation, it can remove 1 corpse token from this model if this model is in its control range. When a friendly Faction warcaster removes a corpse token from this model, the warcaster gains 1 focus point. Each warcaster can do this only once per turn.

name: Revulsion
description: While this model has a corpse token, it gains Stealth.

name: •Dark Blessing
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to gain +1 DEF. Dark Blessing lasts for one round.

name: Bond (Prowl)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Soul Bank
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, once during each of your Leader’s activations it can remove one soul token from this model to gain one focus point.

name: Funeral Rites
description: Once per turn, when a a friendly living Ghost of Ios model is destroyed by an enemy attack while in Morayne's control range, immediately after the attack is resolved Morayne can cast a spell without spending focus.

name: Salvage
description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, remove d3 +3 damage points from a model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range.

name: Beast Master
description: This model can force friendly Faction warbeasts within 6" of it as if it were their battlegroup controller.

name: •Flesh-Hardening (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction living warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, continuous effects on it immediately expire and it gains Tough for one round.

name: Vital Magic
description: When a spell or special rule would cause one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, this model can keep one or more of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points for each spell kept in play.

name: Scales of Fate
description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack or damage roll during its activation while in this model’s control range, this model can suffer d3 damage points to cause that model to reroll that roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Scales of Fate. This damage cannot be transferred.

name: Clear!
description: This model’s ranged attacks against friendly models automatically miss.

name: Leadership [Mage Hunter]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Mage Hunter models gain Sprint.

name: Arcane Annihilation
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, models within 8" of it lose their focus and fury points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, summon horrors, or be forced for one round.

name: •Thrall Crafting
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to put one friendly Corpse Crawler into play for each token spent. You can have up to three friendly Corpse Crawlers in play at any time for each friendly Necroharvester in play. Place the Crawlers B2B with this model.

name: Body Snatcher: Harvester
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack within 8" of this model or when a living or undead enemy model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: Body Snatcher: Corpse Harvester
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead model is destroyed within 8" of this model or a Grunt in its unit, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Resurrectionist (★Action)
description: Remove up to three corpse tokens from this model to return one small-based friendly Grunt to a Thrall unit for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within within 8" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Thrall]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Thrall model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Grim Returns (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

name: Spare Parts
description: When a warjack is destroyed within 5" of this model, it gains one scrap token. This model can have up to three scrap tokens at any time. Before making a repair roll, this model can spend one scrap token to add +2 to its roll

name: Create Scrap Thrall (★Action)
description: Remove one or more scrap tokens from this model, then roll a d3 for each scrap token removed. Place up to that number of Scrap Thralls into play completely within 3" of this model. A placed Scrap Thrall must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play

name: Flank [Angel]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Angel model, this model gains +2 to the attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Playing Dead
description: At any time during its activation, Grunts in this model’s unit are knocked down. Additionally Grunts in this model’s unit gain Feign Death for one round. (A mode with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

name: Fire’s Fury
description: This model gains +5 ARM against fire damage. While suffering the Fire continuous effect, this model cannot become knocked down and gains boosted attack and damage rolls.

name: Self-Immolation (★Action)
description: This model suffers the fire continuous effect.

name: Pyg
description: This model is a Pyg model.

name: •Cold Snap (★Action)
description: This model gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

name: •Freak Storm (★Action)
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. Then place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location. The template remains in play for one round.

name: •Frostbite (★Attack)
description: Frostbite is a RNG SP 8 arcane attack. Models hit suffer a POW 12 cold damage roll. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: Hunter’s Reckoning
description: This model can use Hunter’s Reckoning once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. When it does, choose a new enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. The previously chosen model/unit is no longer this unit’s prey.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Reaver Guard]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Reaver Guard within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Silence
description: This model does not have to make Berserk attacks.

name: Apparition
description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

name: Field Marshal [Treewalker]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Treewalker.

name: Hellhounds
description: When a Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, while the Cohort model is within 12" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Arcane Reinforcement (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Arcane Reinforcement lasts for one turn.

name: Holy Bonds
description: Enemy models cannot gain this model’s soul token.

name: Field Marshal [Homicidal Maniac]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Homicidal Maniac.

name: •Vitalizer (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

name: Veteran Leader [Paingiver Bloodrunners]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Paingiver Bloodrunner models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Mercenary]
description: This model and friendly Mercenary models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Pain Driver (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

name: Scutter (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Temper Flesh (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

name: Leadership [Trencher]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trencher models gain Dodge.

name: •Extended Range
description: This model’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

name: •Empowered Attack
description: This model gains +2 to damage rolls.

name: Death Void
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy animi and upkeep spells on models within 5" of it immediately expire.

name: Granted: Retaliatory Strike
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Sacrificial Strike (★Action)
description: RNG 12. Target a model in this model’s LOS. If that model is in range, remove one friendly Faction trooper model within 1" of this model from play. The target model suffers an unboostable magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the removed model.

name: Unpredictable Movement
description: When placing unit models during their unit’s Normal Movement, after determining the advancing model’s movement place the remaining troopers in the squad within 4" of that model, not 2".

name: Granted: Unyielding
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Penetrating Strike
description: When this model hits a warjack, warbeast, or horror with a melee attack, you can choose to have the model hit suffer 1 damage point instead of a damage roll.

name: Leadership [Angels]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Angel models gain Apparition.

name: Launch Servitor
description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Attunement Servitor solo into play completely witn in 2" of this model.

name: Power Grid
description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Ionization Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model. There can be up to 3 Ionization servitors in play per Prime Conflux included in this army.

name: •1 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least one corpse it can run or charge without being forced.

name: •3 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least three corpse tokens, it's weapons gain Grievous Wounds.  (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: •5 or more corpse tokens
description: When this model has at least five corpse tokens this model gains +2 on damage rolls

name: Curse [Shapeshifter]
description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Shapeshifter models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

name: Invoke the Beast
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can cause a friendly Marked model within 8" of it to be replaced with Shapeshifer model that has not yet been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that entered play this turn or that already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When the Shapeshifter model replaces a  model, that model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When the Shapeshifte is destroyed, remove it from play.

name: Veteran Leader [Ordic]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Ordic models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Alchemical Vents
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following Alchemical Vents effects. While within 5" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. While its S system is crippled, this model loses the benefits of Alchemical Vents. Alchemical Vent effects last for one round.

name: •Iron Bane
description: Affected enemy construct models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. A construct suffering Rust suffers –2 ARM.

name: •Miasma of Death
description: Affected living enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them unless they can ignore gas effects.

name: •Unnatural Affliction
description: Affected enemy models lose Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire.

name: Bond [Absylonia]
description: If Proteus begins the game in Absylonia's battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Proteus is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Proteus is bonded to Absylonia and in her control range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Collapse Tunnel (★Action)
description: Remove a friendly Trapdoor marker from anywhere on the table.

name: Make a Hole! (★Action)
description: If there are fewer than three friendly Trapdoor markers on the table, place one within 3" of this model.

name: Redirect (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Choose a friendly Trapdoor marker within range. Place it completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Trapdoor
description:
Trapdoor markers are not models and do not block line of sight. Models can advance through a marker, or be pushed, thrown, or slammed through a marker, if they have enough movement to move completely past it; otherwise, they must stop short of the marker. A slammed or thrown model does not suffer an additional damage die for contacting the marker.

Trapdoor markers cannot be placed overlapping a model’s base, obstacle or obstruction terrain.

A friendly Faction non-Leader warrior model/unit that ends its Normal Movement in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker can immediately go into the tunnels. If it does, it is removed from the table and gains Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. When the model/unit is returned to play, do not remove damage from it. (When a model/unit with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, one model can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table and other models in the unit are placed in base contact with the first model.)

name: Sky Ladder
description: When this model ends its Normal Movement, choose one small or medium-based friendly solo model within 2" of it. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Sky Ladder only once per turn.

name: Airborne Reconnaissance
description: While within 8" of this model, friendly Faction models ignore cloud effects when targeting enemy models.

name: Stew’s On
description: While within 3" of this model, friendly warrior models gain Comfort Food. (If a model with Comfort Food is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast at the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching you can remove the model with Comfort Food from play to remove any number of fury points from the warbeast.)

name: Impenetrable Shield
description: While this model is B2B with one or more friendly Temple Flameguard models, it does not suffer damage from non-magical melee or ranged attacks.

name: •Death Field (★Action)
description: While within 3" of this model, friendly models gain Dark Shroud. Death Field lasts for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Living model]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal living model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Field Marshal [Steady]
description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup cannot become knocked down.

name: Acidic Mist
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Acid Blast
description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.

name: Bog Trog Warlock
description: This model can have only Minion Gatorman warbeasts in its battlegroup.

name: Call to Sacrifice [Bog Trog]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Bog Trog model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Flank [Razor Boar]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Razor Boar, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: •Precision Strike
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.

name: •Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: •Glimpse of Fate
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, it gains Future Sight. Glimpse of Fate lasts for one turn. (A model with Future Sight can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.)

name: •Ashes of Urcaen
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model. If the target model is in range, it gains Ashen Veil. Ashes of Urcaen lasts for one round.

name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

name: Leadership [Reeves of Orboros]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Reeves of Orboros models gain Hunter.

name: Sniper
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Cloaked
description: This model cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks.

name: Hinderance
description: Enemy warjacks within 5" of this model cannot power up.

name: Subterfuge
description: If this model is within 5" of an objective secured by an opponent, score a victory point each time your opponent scores a victory point from that objective.

name: •Dirge of Mists
description: While within 5" of this model, friendly models gain concealment. Dirge of Mists lasts for one round.

name: Channeler [Saeryn]
description: While Rhyas is in Saeryn’s control range, Saeryn can channel spells through her.

name: Twin Sister
description: Saeryn and Rhyas share a single battlegroup. If Saeryn is destroyed or removed from play, Rhyas becomes a warlock and Leader model and is no longer considered to be a solo. Your warlock is destroyed only if both Saeryn and Rhyas are destroyed or removed from play.

name: Supporting Warlock
description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage

name: Diversionary Tactic (★ Action)
description: Models other than Brine within 3" of Rorsh suffer a POW 7 blast damage roll. After these damage rolls are resolved, Rorsh can make a full advance. If Brine was within 3" of Rorsh when he used Diversionary Tactic, Brine can also make a full advance.

name: Farrow Warlock
description: This model can have only Minion Farrow warbeasts in its battlegroup.

name: Souie (★ Action)
description: If Brine is currently in this model’s control range, Brine can immediately make a full advance toward Rorsh.

name: Aggression Dial
description: This model can use Aggression Dial at any time during its activation. This model gains +2 to its melee damage rolls that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Aggression Dial can be used only once per activation.

name: Drive: Shield Guard
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains  Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Partner [Taryn di la Rovissi]
description: While within 10" of Taryn di la Rovissi, this model gains Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Mortal Fear
description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.

name: Soulstorm
description: While this model has one or more soul tokens, enemy models entering or ending their activations within 2" of it immediately suffer 1 point of magical damage.

name: Soul Taker: Crypt of Souls
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. At the start of each of your Control Phases, this model receives d3 soul tokens if it does not have any. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: Channeler [Rhyas]
description: While Saeryn is in Rhyas’s control range, Rhyas can channel spells through her.

name: Granted: Blessed
description: While this model is in play, the weapons of models in its unit gain Blessed.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Satyxis]
description: This model and friendly Satyxis models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Witchcraft
description: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its unit’s activations. Each model in this unit gains the benefits listed.

name: •Red Tide
description: Affected models gain Overtake this activation. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •True Wind
description: Affected models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: •Whipping Winds
description: Affected models gain Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

name: Tracker
description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS when declaring a charge.

name: Granted: Clear!
description: While this model is in play, when a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against a friendly model the attack automatically misses.

name: Smoke Cloud
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model when it makes a ranged attack. The template remains in play for one round.

name: Granted: Feign Death
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

name: Bond [The Old Witch of Khador]
description: If Scrapjack begins the game in the Old Witch’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Scrapjack is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control.
